title: WorkspaceGroup
description: A workspace group is a logical container that groups workspaces sharing a common cloud region, network configuration, and firewall rules within a SingleStore Helios organization.

workspaceGroupID.description: Unique identifier of the workspace group.

name.description: Human-readable name of the workspace group.

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the workspace group.

regionID.description: Identifier of the cloud provider region where the workspace group is deployed.

firewallRanges.description: List of CIDR IP ranges permitted to connect to workspaces in this group.

allowAllTraffic.description: When true, all inbound traffic is allowed regardless of firewall ranges.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the workspace group was created.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp when the workspace group is scheduled to expire and be automatically terminated.
